spanish: Y si no alcanzare su mano a dos tórtolas o a dos hijos de paloma, y traerá su ofrenda que pecó, décima del efa de flor de harina a pecado; no pondrá sobre ella aceite, y no dará sobre ella incienso, porque pecado ella.
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated Hebrew noun sólet (H5560) into the Spanish noun 'flor de harina', the licensed sense for this term.
Inserted the connecting preposition 'de' before 'flor de harina' so the noun-noun sequence 'efa ... flor de harina' is grammatical in Spanish.
readerNote: hold: clause role — the subject of 'que pecó' stays undecided between the person bringing the offering and the masculine offering itself, since חָטָא (qal perfect 3ms) has no expressed subject; that clause is left unchanged.
